light_description: Japanese handmade distortion covering crunch through hard rock and metal, with dual-range tone shaping and a distinctive lacquered enclosure.
Japanese handmade multifunction overdrive with continuously adjustable clipping blend and broad mid/low character control.
Japanese handmade overdrive/booster designed for tube-like crunch, with tone and bass controls and a wide gain range that can approach fuzz-like behavior.
Japanese handmade distortion with boost switching, documented by the builder as a flagship broad-range drive and later production-ending lot.
Japanese-made one-volume fuzz released as an official JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Stone Ocean collaboration with 320design.
South Korean small-batch overdrive reported as a streamlined later state of the Dead Horse design; retained as a research candidate because primary builder documentation remains difficult to locate.
South Korean small-batch fuzz reported as a streamlined later state of the Video Protone fuzz design; retained as a research candidate pending primary identity verification.
